text:
Carmen (PM): Quick design review request — working on the diff-inspector for Prompt Sets/evals. Need feedback on: visual prominence of regressions, keyboard + screenreader flow, and the confirm modal microcopy. Screenshot attached: https://img.redwood.company/ux/diff-inspector.png

Raj (Design): Looks good overall. A couple of UX nits: the regression highlight feels low-contrast in the dark theme; users might miss the baseline marker. Suggest we add a subtle left strip with the baseline label and an explicit 'changed / unchanged' badge. :eyes:

Mike (Frontend): Re: baseline strip — doable. Main constraint: inspector is virtualized list; adding left sticky strip is fine but we should avoid heavy DOM on each row. Also keyboard focus currently lands on the first changed item only — we should provide next/prev keyboard shortcuts.

Anya (UX Research): From the last usability tests, participants missed when multiple regressions landed in the same example. They liked a timeline scrubber that shows counts per run. Also flagged that the confirmation modal copy felt vague: they weren't sure what 'approve changes' meant (approve diffs vs approve prompt set).

Oliver (Eng): Agree on clarifying copy. For the scrubber: we can add an aria-live region announcing "3 regressions, 1 unchanged" when scrubbing so SR users get context. But we need exact copy from design to implement.

Raj (Design): Proposed microcopy options for the modal (short):
1) "Approve these changes to the prompt set. This will mark the new outputs as the baseline for future runs."
2) "Confirm: Set current outputs as the new baseline for this prompt set. This cannot be undone from the UI."
3) "Accept diffs and update baseline — recommended if results are expected for this release."

Carmen (PM): Vote with emoji: which option is clearest? I think 1) is explicit.

Mike (Frontend): +1 on 1). Implementation note: if we include "cannot be undone" we should wire in an undo-surface or link to docs rather than a scary modal line.

a11y-bot: Accessibility checks — color contrast fail on regression highlight in dark theme (AA large text fail). Suggested foreground/background combo: use #0B66A3 on #FFFFFF for light theme highlights, and #BFE6FF on #052A3D for dark theme. Also ensure keyboard shortcuts are documented in the help menu and that the scrubber has role="slider" with aria-valuemin/max.

Raj (Design): Cool — I'll update the mock with the left baseline strip, a small legend, and modal text option 1 with a short "undo docs" link. Also adding focus ring states and visible keyboard affordance.

Oliver (Eng): Action items:
- Raj to upload updated mock by EOD Wed (assigned).
- Mike to prototype keyboard nav + aria-live behavior (PR target: next sprint).
- Anya to run 5 quick remote moderated tests on updated flow.
- Carmen to update release notes copy and link to undo docs.

Mike (Frontend): Quick CSS snippet for focus order and visible baseline strip I can push as a starting point:

```css
.diff-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 48px 1fr; align-items: center; }
.baseline-strip { width: 48px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(11,102,163,0.08), rgba(11,102,163,0.04)); padding: 8px; font-size: 12px; }
.diff-row:focus { outline: 3px solid #BFE6FF; outline-offset: 2px; }
```

Carmen (PM): Thanks — let's sync tomorrow 10:30am PT to triage any blocking items. If anyone can't make it, drop a short note in this thread. :calendar:
